_README: HSF VOTER GUIDE - BASE FILE (configuration and legal copy)
This file holds everything volunteers must NOT touch: settings, the paid-for
disclaimer, publisher name, methodology note, category labels, county list,
ballot level order, and theme colors.
data.base.json     (this file)  - config and legal copy. Editor-owned.
data.content.json               - races, entries, organizations. Comes from the Google Sheet.
data.json          (generated)  - the two above merged. This is what the site reads.
Never hand-edit data.json. Edit this file or the sheet, then re-run the converter.
counties lists all 15 Arizona counties. This is the MASTER list the
converter validates against. data.json only carries the counties that
actually have published content, so voters never hit an empty filter.
Replace every TODO in settings before publishing.
Validate edits before publishing - one missing comma blanks the site.

settings.tagline: Hold the Line. Seize New Ground. Fight Like Hell.
settings.paid_for_by: Paid for by Hold Seize Fight. With 0% from out-of-state contributors. Not Authorized by a Candidate.
settings.methodology_note: Hold Seize Fight selects candidates based on incumbents or candidates for office who embrace justice, democracy, and equality. Entries are researched from campaign materials, public records, and endorsements from allied organizations, then written and reviewed by volunteers before publication. To suggest a correction or a candidate we've missed, write to hsfvote@gmail.com.

categories.blurb: Incumbents in office who are doing the work. Defend these seats.
Candidates committed to going further than the seat's current occupant.
Organizations on the front lines. Show up, give, volunteer.
